stories.title: Android Platform Hardware-to-Cockpit Service Bridge
stories.description: Wire HomeViewModel to the live Android IntercomForegroundService, connecting real Push-To-Talk audio capture/playback, live BLE mesh peers, real-time RMS audio levels, and GPS/canned hazard mesh packet routing.
acceptanceCriteria: HomeViewModel binds cleanly to platform hardware intercom provider interface without violating KMP separation
StartTransmitting/StopTransmitting triggers live AudioEngine recording and BLE mesh audio packet dispatch
Real BLE mesh peer roster flows into HomeUiState.peers replacing static mocks
Live microphone input level and speaker output level flow from AudioEngine into HomeUiState meters
Outgoing canned hazard and GPS telemetry packets route directly to MeshTransport broadcast
Zero regressions in existing multiplatform test suites

stories.title: Multiplatform Production Release Build & ProGuard Hardening
stories.description: Configure release build targets, versioning (versionCode = 2, versionName = '2.0.0'), Proguard/R8 obfuscation rules for KMP/Ktor/Serialization, and verify assembleRelease for Android and XCFramework for iOS.
acceptanceCriteria: ProGuard rules safely preserve kotlinx.serialization models and Koin bindings
App bundle size is optimized with minification enabled

stories.title: Long-Running Battery, WakeLock & Memory Profiling Gate
stories.description: Validate 4-hour background mesh continuity, CPU WakeLock acquisition/release semantics, and verify RAM stays bounded <80MB total (with <3MB blackbox cache).
acceptanceCriteria: WakeLock acquire/release is strictly balanced across PTT and standby states
Memory footprint benchmark confirms LZ77 compressed blackbox stays bounded <1MB under 3000 frames
Background audio routing releases SCO cleanly upon service termination

stories.title: Architecture Sync, Documentation & v2.0.0 Release Tagging
stories.description: Update project documentation (PRD.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, TASKS.md, SPRINT.md, CHANGELOG.md), regenerate knowledge graph and archify diagrams, tag release v2.0.0, and merge sprint branch to develop.
acceptanceCriteria: 100% of Definition of Done criteria met across all stories
Graphify knowledge base synced with zero errors
Clean git commit history with semantic versioning tag v2.0.0
